title: Standing Easels Don’t Work
text: Standing Easels Don’t Work. Used for gallery wall photos because the standing easel do not work. Easel attachment do not line up to balance the frames😏. However for a plastic frame w/ ease of front load I like these enough to keep & not return them. Price point played major part in my decision to do so. Positive aspect is the manufacturer super secure safety packaging. Frames are good if you need gallery style hanging only.
